_source: Nox Box Mechanism artifact (claude.ai/code/artifact/cfe4560d-d81c-44b6-9ca7-2e51a6b592ad), read 2026-10-17. Its layout numbers are marked C (from arm_layout.py / box-*.md), its motion times E (estimates). Every value marked ASSUMED or PROVISIONAL below must be confirmed on the real mechanism before it carries a pack.

roles._note: ASSUMED: which board motor drives what was not identified yet. Confirm by jogging (README, 'Swap wheel').

wheel._note: Axle motor on the arm walks a 20T pulley round the fixed 80T sun (artifact: 'a flat band from the 80T to the axle motor's 20T'): 80/20 = 4 motor deg per wheel deg. dir = +1 if a clockwise motor turn raises phi (ASSUMED +1).
wheel._limits_note: ASSUMED: the arm carries the head motors, so their cables limit how far it may turn. [-300, 90] is exactly what the 9 bays + the top need (A: -210..90, B: -300..0). Narrow it if the cables have less slack.

heads._note: Each head rides a belt on its bar, driven by a 20T pulley. The artifact draws the belt strands 12.7 mm apart = a 20T GT2 pulley's pitch diameter, so 40 mm per motor turn (INFERRED, confirm the belt). dir per head = +1 if a clockwise motor turn extends the head (ASSUMED).
heads._ext_note: Head positions along the bar, the artifact's Z0_PARK / Z0_BAY / Z0_WAIT / Z0_DRONE (C).

grippers._note: PROVISIONAL: servo angles for blades open / closed (closed = gripping the cartridge tab). The artifact's blades travel 5 mm on a ~6 mm pinion, ~48 deg of servo, so 66 / 114 around centre. Calibrate on the real gripper before it holds a pack (README).
